wish: someone should make an app that calculates distance and elevation gain from a GPX file
spec:
Reads a GPX track, route or waypoint file and shows total distance, elevation gain and loss, high and low points, total and moving time, pace, speed and an elevation profile.
Open or drop a .gpx file (or paste its text) and the numbers appear; one tap switches km/m and mi/ft.
It does not upload anything, edit tracks, show a map, or fill in missing elevation from terrain data.
notes: Elevation gain uses a 3 m hysteresis to suppress GPS noise. Moving time counts segments faster than 0.5 m/s with gaps under 10 minutes. Sample track is generated locally, not a real recording.
